label: Order confirmation
info: Confirms an order to the customer on WhatsApp: POST /whatsapp/orders from your shop.

name: Setup
info: Before you run this flow: open the Turbo Notify account node, paste an API key and press Test. Your Turbo Notify account needs a WhatsApp number linked to it. The key needs the messages:send scope. First set the variable ALERT_TOKEN of this tab (double-click the tab, then Environment variables) to a long random string of at least 16 characters: until you do, the endpoint refuses every call with 503. Whoever holds the token can send a message to any number from your number, so keep it secret and serve Node-RED over https. Your shop posts the order to http://localhost:1880/whatsapp/orders with the x-token header: {"id":"A-1001","customer":{"name":"Ana","phone":"+12025550123"},"items":[{"qty":2,"name":"Coffee beans"}],"total":"31.80","currency":"USD"}. Edit the template node to change the words. Only send to customers who gave you their number to hear about their order.
